capabilities: Highlight a clicked heading and its related content in Reading mode
Focus a single paragraph or block instead of a heading section
Dim unrelated elements with adjustable opacity and animation speed
Clear the focus state by clicking again or clicking outside the reading area
Support independent focus states across multiple panes
disambiguation: Not a text-highlighting tool; it dims everything except the heading or block you click while reading.
extras: Edit-mode support is listed as a TODO and is not available yet; list focusing is marked experimental and only works on first-level lists; the Click Outside clear method may misbehave when Readable line length is off.
problem: In Reading mode Obsidian shows the whole note at once, so it is hard to visually concentrate on a single heading or paragraph.

relations.evidence: With the Style Settings plugin installed and enabled, you can further customize some visual properties

summary: Reading-mode helper that highlights the clicked heading or block and dims the rest of the note to keep attention on one section.
